transcript: Everything has a process. I do not pressure my life to go in one way over the other. Processes remind me to think critically to take my time. The more that I prioritize allowing processes to happen, the less inclined I feel to take information from any and everywhere. Process reminds me that I have all the tools and the resources to make proper decisions, to maneuver in situations. I am never confused because I allow moments to be what they are. I allow the process to reveal itself.
